title: Decision Benchmark, ap-invoices-my-sg, v0.9: output for one case
description: One JSON object per case (JSONL). Output that breaks this schema, or names two decisions, is scored as a wrong decision. See docs/task-sets/ap-invoices-my-sg/spec-v0.9.md.

tax_treatment.description: Singapore codes for SG cases, Malaysian codes for MY cases. A code from the other country is a wrong tax treatment, not a schema error. null only when decision is HAND_OVER.

gl_account.description: One code from the company's chart of accounts. Scored as exact match. null only when decision is HAND_OVER.

reason_codes.description: Short codes explaining the decision. A recommended list is in reason-codes.md; it is not enforced in v0.9.

confidence.description: Optional. Needed for the risk-coverage curve.

explanation.description: Optional free text. Never scored on the leaderboard.
